report.headline: 138 collectible tests this pass (command-center/, 2 non-hermetic salvage/scratch trees excluded, see fixtures/collectible_scope.py). Probe1 raw (3 shuffled seeds [1001, 2002, 5005], shuffle-actually-reordered control=True): 2 candidate(s) that passed at baseline and failed under at least one shuffle. Probe2 (5 identical-order repeats, order-held-constant control=True): 1 test(s) that disagree with themselves even with order held constant. Cross-referencing the two (the catalog's own point: a single shuffled failure alone cannot tell order-dependence apart from plain nondeterminism): 1 of the 2 probe1 candidate(s) are ALSO flaky under a held-constant order and are therefore flake, not order-dependence, leaving 1 genuinely order-dependent test(s) this pass. All flagged tests in both categories are the deliberately planted ground-truth fixtures (real 135-test corpus: 0 order-dependent, 0 flaky this pass). Detection method proven live: both ground-truth fixtures were caught and correctly classified (probe1_ground_truth_ok=True, probe2_ground_truth_ok=True).
